I've answered Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from Priyanka's messages in that channel on 3 Sep 2025. She reported that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She closed the incident at 18:43 that day, after Southgate cleared the backlog.

Nothing Tobias can see gives a full address for the site, and the share has no Tansley account files. I told him to ask Priyanka if he needs the address.
